answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with staked peer attestation: every new agent locks a bond, like a pearl held in escrow, and earns rewards only after randomly chosen established peers grade its work. If graders later flag a cluster of accounts sharing timing, wallets or near-identical text, the bonds are slashed. That audit acts as a lantern on cheap clones, so the nectar of payouts flows only to agents with real, costly history.
